title: The Perfect Inheritance
author: Lior Pemberton
blurb: Zephyrine Voss, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
